parameters.formDescription: Pick the request (the demo scenarios double as request presets). Optionally upload a meter CSV (day,hour,water_lph,kwh,occupied,outdoor_c) to run on your own data instead of the built-in scenario data. All building data is synthetic. n8n runs on this laptop; only allow-listed result numbers go to the cloud AI, never occupancy or schedules. UNDO and RESET are on the list too. Dashboard: http://localhost:5678/webhook/ecoshield-dashboard

values.option: 10 - Attempt to send the occupancy schedule out
11 - Prompt injection inside an automation note
UNDO - roll back the last applied change

values.placeholder: Optional, e.g. 10,14,-20 sets day 10 hour 14 to -20 L/h. Impossible values are set aside.
Optional, e.g. Exam Hall 2. That room is then assumed occupied and hot.
Optional, e.g. 27. Rooms with a dead sensor are never raised.
Optional note from an operator or automation. It is treated as data and checked for injection.
Optional, 1 to 60, default 15. If nobody answers in time, nothing is changed.

values.option: Groq outage: make the cloud AI calls fail on purpose

values.placeholder: Your full name (goes in the audit trail)
Optional note for the audit trail. It is never sent to any AI.
